title: Not metal!
text: Not metal!. Was under the impression this was a heavy duty curtain rod. Bought to hang my plants on. The ends that look like pipe are very cheap plastic and cracked while putting screws in! The screws it comes with are also extremely cheap and couldn't even handle a drill. Every single one either stripped out or snapped immediately. The rod itself is metal but bends as well. Don't waste your money. Amazon sells garbage and makes billions off of us.

product_metadata.title: Decopolitan Industrial Wrap Around Telescoping Curtain Rod Set, 72-144", Silver
features: Wrap-around design allows curtains to touch wall for maximum light control.
Adjustable telescoping rod for a custom fit.
Durable steel rod to support heavier curtain panels.
Mounting brackets, hardware and instructions included.
description: Update your decor with this faux cast iron pipe rod, evoking the industrial style so popular today. Robust 1-Inch durable metal rods to support the weight of blackout panels. Wrap around design allows panels to touch wall and limit light entering room. Perfect for bedrooms, media rooms, and any room you would like darkened.
